job.job_description:
Job Post: Gen AI Engineer

Working Location: Remote US Time
Working Hours: 8 AM EST to 5 PM EST
Working Days: Monday to Friday

Salary Slab: 90K - 1.20 lakh per month

Looking for a Gen AI Engineer for remote contract engagements supporting client-facing AI implementations for a USA-based company

The role involves building production-grade Generative AI solutions on AWS, including conversational AI, RAG-based systems, intelligent automation platforms, and data-driven AI pipelines.

Must Have Skills: AWS Bedrock, Agents & Serverless AI
We are looking for professionals with strong hands-on expertise in:

Amazon Bedrock and foundation model integrations
Agent orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, LlamaIndex, Bedrock Agents)
Advanced Python (3.9+) and API development
Serverless AWS architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions)
Vector databases and semantic search implementations
Data engineering workflows, including ETL pipeline development
AWS Glue for data processing and orchestration
Amazon Athena for querying and analytics
Strong understanding of structured/unstructured data handling for AI systems


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
